text: What if building a company meant creating an organization that could improve itself?
Meet GENESIS. An AI-native company where specialized agents turn a founder's mission into coordinated work.
Research analyzes CORE. Engineering delivers working software. Operations verifies the result with real tests.
Product testing gathers two hundred AI-simulated perspectives, and checks real workflows in Chrome.
Then GENESIS improves itself. One verification policy rises from four to six passing cases. A later mutation shows no gain, so it's rejected.
The company does the work. The founder keeps control of consequential decisions.
CORE is the future we're building. GENESIS is the company learning how to build it.
